identity.one_liner: Considered, small-batch fashion in natural fibres for people who buy less but buy better.
identity.target_customer: 28-45 year old urban professionals who value craftsmanship and provenance over trend cycles; low purchase frequency, high average order value, researches before buying.
value_props: Made-to-last construction, not seasonal trend cycles

tone.voice_notes: Reads like a design journal, not an ad. Leads with craft and material story before price or promotion.

customers.summary: Skews premium and loyal-core: low discount-code usage, high AOV, low cart-abandonment, values exclusivity over price.

market_memory.patterns.pattern_statement: Creator/customer-style short-form video content tends to outperform polished static product imagery on engagement.
Adding explicit size/fit reassurance (try-on video, size-chart callout, fit guide) to the product page tends to reduce cart abandonment.
Social-proof/UGC-led creative only resonates with a narrower slice of the target segment than expected, worth narrowing targeting rather than a broad rollout.

brief.supplier_power: Supplier power is not directly assessed from available brand memory for fashion_d2c.
brief.competitive_rivalry: Competitive rivalry is elevated with 3 named competitors actively contesting fashion_d2c.
brief.threat_of_substitutes: Substitute threat exists from adjacent fashion_d2c brands and marketplace private labels.
brief.threat_of_new_entrants: New-entrant threat is present given generally low barriers to entry in fashion_d2c D2C.

constraints.product: Small-batch natural-fibre production; Traceable maker/sourcing story; Made-to-last construction, not seasonal trend cycles
constraints.price: Reflects the brand's real premium price posture.
constraints.place: Primarily direct-to-consumer via the brand's own site/app, discovered through Instagram/Reels-native content.
constraints.promotion: Creator/customer-style short-form video content tends to outperform polished static product imagery on engagement.
constraints.people: Reads like a design journal, not an ad. Leads with craft and material story before price or promotion.
hard_rules: No discount language anywhere, this line never goes on sale
Nothing that reads like a catalog spec sheet either, keep it editorial
And the maker/sourcing story has to be front and center, not an afterthought.
Never use discount-led or price-first language; lead with material/craft/provenance story instead.
